## Experience

- WLF Club (GTM Engineer, May 2026-present, Fort Worth TX, remote from Austin since Aug 2026): rebuilt wlfclub.com in-house, replacing a $15,000 agency build that still had 12 Lorem Ipsum pages live in production (30+ pages, new hosting, verify-gated deploy pipeline, ending agency billing entirely). Migrated the clinic's DNS to Cloudflare with zero downtime and zero mail interruption, verifying 29 records and SPF/DKIM/DMARC under a p=reject policy before cutover. Built Warvis, an internal RAG assistant hosted for the whole team, and a member health portal (Cloudflare Workers + D1) replacing paid HeadsUp Health software: WHOOP/Apple Health wearable sync, a 17-marker labs engine, and a companion native app live on TestFlight.
- Webspansion & Prospansion (founder, Apr 2024-present): Webspansion (free tier) is a pro bono studio: 19+ free live websites shipped as community service for nonprofits, immigrant-owned local businesses, and community groups, solo, accessibility-first, intake through deploy. Prospansion (paid tier) is the technical/data arm offering analytics, SEO, and automation; its flagship is Prospansion Studio, a multi-tenant Cloudflare Workers + D1 CMS with hardened auth (invite-only signup, hashed tokens, single-use resets) and a fixed sanitizer-bypass XSS vulnerability verified via exploit proof-of-fix, deployed for nonprofit client Ocura.

## Projects

- Warvis: RAG knowledge system ingesting 700+ documents into a cited hybrid-search graph (SQLite FTS5 + local embeddings) with a HIPAA-aware PHI-scanning gate and fail-closed access control on every query (229 passing tests). Built at WLF Club, hosted for the whole team.
- [Guruji](https://getguruji.com): gamified Duolingo-style learning PWA (React, TypeScript, Supabase) with RLS-scoped auth and a self-run security audit against the live database (zero exploitable vulnerabilities). Multi-track curriculum: Data Decoded (data science) and QuickClaude (coding) alongside English and digital-literacy content.
- [BohoQuest](https://app.bohoquest.app): gamified check-in app (Expo/React Native) with server-side anti-cheat verification, Apple Sign-In, and a 121-test suite. Live in TestFlight.
- [PickMyPath](https://app.pickmypath.app): guitar-learning app, live but paused: chord-aligned lyrics, 73-song structured dataset, recommendation engine (Next.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL).
- [BohoBites Analytics](https://github.com/ashmitbohora/bohobites_dashboard): Python/Shiny dashboard processing real TikTok creator data (rolling KPI windows, posting-time models) for BohoBites, a 7K+ follower food brand.
- [BohoBites](https://ashmitbohora.com/bohobites/): first-person POV food series filmed on smart glasses at small independent restaurants, 7,000+ TikTok followers at [@.bohobites](https://www.tiktok.com/@.bohobites). Started in Dallas-Fort Worth, now filming "Boho's 100 Bites of Austin." Collab and press contact: bohobitesofficial@gmail.com.
- BoHub: local-first AI personal OS: Claude API tiered model routing, SQLite full-text search, security model.
